title: SLAs and support contracts for custom software: what should be in them?

points.heading: What an SLA actually promises
points.body: An SLA isn't a vague reassurance that "we'll take care of you." It's a specific, measurable commitment.

points.heading: Severity tiers: the part most SLAs get wrong
points.body: A good SLA doesn't treat every issue the same.

points.heading: What a support contract should cover beyond the SLA

cta.headline: The full piece is on the site.
cta.sub: What a usable SLA actually promises, how severity tiers work, what a support contract should cover, and what it typically costs per year.
